list.name: Changes
list.comment:
refactor(apps): replace outdated apps with unified Farm_Eazy app for Vendor & Customer
- Removed non-functional `websites/` and outdated `customer` and `vendor-delivery_partner` apps - Integrated new Flutter 3.27.x based Farm_Eazy app with clean architecture - Added support for dual app variants: Vendor & Customer - Implemented Provider for state management and Material 3 UI - Integrated secure Firebase Authentication, Firestore, and Storage - Enabled light/dark mode theming - Added GenAI chatbot to assist farmers with actionable recommendations
